title: Curve Selection Control Points Visible
description: When selecting a curve in CAD, control points should be visible in the viewport.
summary: Curve edge/wire selection now shows NURBS poles for all nurbs curves (control-point and through/interpolate), not only `through: true`. Renamed helpers to `nurbsPolesFromEdge` / `geometryEntityNurbsPoles`; `SpatialPickTargetNode` renders spheres on select/hover. Added unit test for control-point curves.
